in_marathi.name: Avanisha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avanisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avanisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ava' meaning 'towards' and 'nis' meaning 'inner self' and 'shakti' meaning 'power'. This name signifies the inner joy and radiance that one experiences when they connect with their inner self.
